style: Single object inventory icon for a painterly 2D adventure game set in the Russian North around 1900-1920. Soft hand-painted digital painting with visible brushstrokes, warm muted palette of umber, ochre, faded green and cream, gentle light from the upper left, soft subtle shadow under the object, three-quarter view, centered, the object fills about 80 percent of the frame. No text, no letters, no numbers, no border, no frame, plain empty background
